author: Will_29
body:
> I have a base stone unsure where I got it from. 

Guild reward. Getting to level 3 in the Titanfelled Guild gives you a tower core. You get a second one at level 10.

> Unsure what tower I should build if building one is the right move. 

I'm not sure if building your own tower makes sense for late T9 or if you should waiting until reaching T10; I was already T10 when they were introduced.

As for which tower, go with the class you want to focus on.

Summoner/Grand Summoner: Eos

Bahamut/Beowulf: Selene

Nyx/Realmshifter: Prometheus

Omnimancer/Heretic: Oceanus

Titanguard/Gilgamesh: Themis

The Deity line can go either way between Oceanus (magic), Themis (physical), Selene (hybrid).

author: dreambig5
body:
Everyone has a different strategy. I would highly suggest building the base towers with the cores and running them all once a day. You'll get around 1-1.5k towershards but more importantly, if you can beat the final tower raid boss, you'll pick up plenty of adorns for celestial weapons!! (Crucial). You get 2 free Tower Cores if you level up your Titanfeld guild to lvl 10 (so you just need to buy the other 3 which is pretty inexpensive).

That, plus, with certain events that deal with Towers, you just need the base (for example last months towers of Oliphest plus Olympia coin gave me 50k shards easy for 15 floors). 

Ideally, you want 450k-600k+ towershards before hitting T10. Once you reach T10, the towers get ALOT harder for a new T10. Enough for one or two Celestial classes and one or two celestial weapons maxed.

\---------

Best way to try and find towers: Build for VD so you can see more of what is around you.

I use my Majestic Class with Seeker specialization. I have an amity that gives another +5% vd.

Then I have 2 Fey Helhests (normal Helhest or Surtr sword could also work) godforged & fully adorned with Symbols of War (each one adds VD). Headpiece = Ornaversary has 2 really pieces (Argos & Covyn's Porcelain Mask. Both give +20% vd). Accessories = Unfelled Concords are best (VD bonus and quicker Dungeon cooldown), but without those, Lanterns/Lasting Lantern or Midnight Eyes. 

Use a torch & farsight potion + once a day light the brazier from your keep/fortress/castle/lookout. 

With everything, I usually get between 1100 m to 1500 m VD. Now with the Traveler's Bonus, if I can pick up level 1 & level 2 bonuses, that goes even further! 

\------

Advice for making early T10 bearable!

I managed to pick up quite a few tower shards for my T10 alt during last months event. I've found Celestial Axe with couple of my highest ward adorns, plus the rest with ward regen adorns (Sturdy feet of Prometheus) has been working great for running Grand Summoner or Beowulf class.

\-------
